headline: Intercontinental Exchange Approves Third Quarter Dividend of $0.52 per Share
summary: ATLANTA & NEW YORK, July 30, 2026--Intercontinental Exchange (NYSE: ICE), one of the world’s leading providers of financial market technology and data powering global capital markets, announced today a $0.52 per share dividend for the third quarter of 2026, which is up 8% from the $0.48 per share dividend paid in the third quarter of 2025. The cash dividend is payable on September 30, 2026 to stockholders of record as of September 16, 2026. The ex-dividend date is September 16, 2026.
